supersedes.why: The released tuple on expungement.ai. Superseded because Checkout sold an ad-hoc Product per Session, so a product-restricted coupon could never match the line item.

That binding froze cc4d8275 with worker c177eef1 / sha256:57bb99a8 and was never re-bound as the worker moved on. Production worker deploy run 35212154510 refused on exactly that: the publication evidence named 35d33755 / sha256:d7e0d4a6, published and accepted, while this record still named the older pair. The refusal was correct and this record is the repair.

applicationPin.why: The Vercel build takes a git commit, so the application pin is the commit whose TREE the deployment is built from -- not a filtered subset of it. This commit carries the publication receipt and the Grade-A route observations that name sha256:df6c2965e1f569fab5b2d9370b97723170c2c49da7a54f93ffc132525b781d06, the worker the deployment runs beside. Pinning c88f10341fec848b3f6f4dec9fc3381e6eea0530 instead would have deployed an application whose own records named the superseded worker.
